theorem actual_weighted_moment_factorization (a u i k : ℕ) (hu : u ≤ a) (m : ℕ → ℕ) (hi : i < u) (hm : ∀ j < u,0 < m j) (x y : Ports a) : VBound (jetWeight a u i m+k) (crossingFirst a u i m x y- (momentWeightedLeft a u i k m*momentRight a u i k hu m) x y)
